ownerLimited: the runtime dialog fit: runtimeDialogLayout(runtimeDialogLayout, viewportLayer...) picks a target occupancy (DEFAULT_TARGET_OCCUPANCY 0.76, COMPACT_TARGET_OCCUPANCY 0.7 when data-runtimeDialogLayout === 'compact') and clamps it into [MAX_PREFERRED_SCALE 1.6, FILL_MAX_SCALE 2 / TIGHT_FILL_MAX_SCALE 2.12]; runtimeDialogViewport returns the visible rectangle (visibleLeftPx/visibleWidthPx) from the intersection of the layer and the dashboard.

the airer visual: appendAirerVisual builds one inline SVG (airerBodyElement, airerGlowElement, airerLampElement, airerLiftsElement, airerRackElement) with per-slot rackSlotIndex and an airerPositionLabel/airerPosition pair taken from the entity state.

the switch visual: createSwitchVisual + syncSwitchState(stateValue, isUnavailable, isPending, isSuccess) keep switchElement, auraElement, plateElement, indicatorElement, rockerElement, offMarkElement/onMarkElement and copyElement/copyLabelElement/copyStateElement in step with isSwitchOn and isCompact/isMomentary.

the hex-colour helpers: mixHexColors(fromColor, toColor, mixRatio), normalizeHexColor(colorInput, trimmedColor, sixDigitColor, hexDigit) and hexChannelAt(hexColor, channelOffset) (fn3 = parseInt(hexColor.slice(offset, offset+2), 16)) are the only colour maths in the file.

the component selection path: the transform chain resolves world transforms by walking component parents (componentTransformChain, chainStartComponentId, accumulatedTransform, worldTransformComponentId) and maps a world point back into each entry's local space (localPoint -> worldPoint with entryScale/rotationRadians/offsetLocalX/offsetLocalY).

newConcepts: the runtime dialog geometry: a two-stage fit (occupancy then scale clamp) shared by every runtime dialog, driven by the dashboard rectangle rather than the viewport.
the component-record convention: a plain object with position and style.scale (not a DOM node) - the reason the shape oracle's 'style' evidence was wrong here.

the panel-renderer base class: constructor(container, options) with setDocument(nextDocument, targetPagePath) and setEntityCatalog(entityCatalog, entityTranslations, deviceCatalog) plus render hooks, subclassed by every concrete renderer in this file and in registry.js.

the entity-resolution ladder for a component: componentInput -> powerComponentInput/runtimeComponent -> candidateEntityId -> deviceProfileRecord -> resolvedEntityId, with pendingEntityDetailsRequest/isCatalogReason scheduling a retry when the catalog is not ready.
